1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Enhanced graphics: starfield background, ship thrust flame, asteroid shading
3: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   // Create starfield background
8:   const stars = [];
9:   const starCount = 100;
10:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
11:     stars.push({
12:       x: Math.random() * width,
13:       y: Math.random() * height,
14:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
15:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
16:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
17:     });
18:   }
19:   if (!canvas) return;
20:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
21:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
22:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
23:   // Audio setup
24:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
25:   // Ensure AudioContext starts after user interaction
26:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
27:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
28:   }, { once: true });
29:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
30:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
31:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
32:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
38:   }
39:   function playThrust() { playBeep(300, 0.05); }
40:   function playCrash() { playBeep(100, 0.3); }
41: 
42:   // ----- Ship -----
43:   // Add thrust flame rendering when accelerating
44:   const ship = {
45:     // track thrust for flame rendering
46:     thrusting: false,
47:     x: width / 2,
48:     y: height / 2,
49:     r: 15, // radius for collision
50:     angle: 0,
51:     vx: 0,
52:     vy: 0,
53:     thrust: 0.1,
54:     rotateSpeed: 0.05,
55:     update() {
56:       // Apply velocity damping
57:       this.vx *= 0.99;
58:       this.vy *= 0.99;
59:       this.x += this.vx;
60:       this.y += this.vy;
61:       // Wrap around edges
62:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += width;
63:       if (this.x > width) this.x -= width;
64:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += height;
65:       if (this.y > height) this.y -= height;
66:     },
67:     draw() {
68:       // Draw thrust flame if accelerating
69:       if (this.thrusting) {
70:         ctx.save();
71:         ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
72:         ctx.rotate(this.angle);
73:         ctx.beginPath();
74:         ctx.moveTo(0, 12);
75:         ctx.lineTo(4, 20);
76:         ctx.lineTo(-4, 20);
77:         ctx.closePath();
78:         ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
79:         ctx.fill();
80:         ctx.restore();
81:       }
82:       // Draw ship body
83:       ctx.save();
84:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
85:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
86:       ctx.beginPath();
87:       ctx.moveTo(0, -12);
88:       ctx.lineTo(8, 12);
89:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 12);
90:       ctx.closePath();
91:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
92:       ctx.fill();
93:       ctx.restore();
94:     },
95:     accelerate() {
96:       this.vx += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.thrust;
97:       this.vy += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.thrust;
98:       playThrust();
99:     }
100:   };
101: 
102:   // ----- Asteroids -----
103:   const asteroids = [];
104:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
105:   const asteroidMaxSpeed = 2;
106:   const asteroidMinRadius = 10;
107:   const asteroidMaxRadius = 30;
108: 
109:   function spawnAsteroid() {
110:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
111:     let x, y, vx, vy;
112:     // Spawn just outside a random edge
113:     if (edge === 0) { // top
114:       x = Math.random() * width;
115:       y = -asteroidMaxRadius;
116:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * asteroidMaxSpeed;
117:       vy = Math.random() * asteroidMaxSpeed + 0.5;
118:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
119:       x = width + asteroidMaxRadius;
120:       y = Math.random() * height;
121:       vx = -Math.random() * asteroidMaxSpeed - 0.5;
122:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * asteroidMaxSpeed;
123:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
124:       x = Math.random() * width;
125:       y = height + asteroidMaxRadius;
126:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * asteroidMaxSpeed;
127:       vy = -Math.random() * asteroidMaxSpeed - 0.5;
128:     } else { // left
129:       x = -asteroidMaxRadius;
130:       y = Math.random() * height;
131:       vx = Math.random() * asteroidMaxSpeed + 0.5;
132:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * asteroidMaxSpeed;
133:     }
134:     const radius = Math.random() * (asteroidMaxRadius - asteroidMinRadius) + asteroidMinRadius;
135:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: radius });
136:   }
137: 
138:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, asteroidSpawnInterval);
139: 
140:   // ----- Input -----
141:   const keys = {};
142:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
143:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
144: 
145:   // ----- Game loop -----
146:   let startTime = null;
147:   let gameOver = false;
148:   let crashPlayed = false;
149: 
150:   function checkCollision(a, b) {
151:     const dx = a.x - b.x;
152:     const dy = a.y - b.y;
153:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
154:     return dist < a.r + b.r;
155:   }
156: 
157:   function update(timestamp) {
158:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
159:     const dt = timestamp - (startTime || timestamp);
160:     if (gameOver) {
161:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
162:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
163:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
164:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
165:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
166:       const secs = ((timestamp - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
167:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${secs}s`, width / 2 - 60, height / 2 + 30);
168:       return;
169:     }
170: 
171:     // Input handling
172:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
173:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
174:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) { ship.accelerate(); ship.thrusting = true; }
175:     else { ship.thrusting = false; }
176: 
177:     ship.update();
178: 
179:     // Update asteroids
180:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
181:       const a = asteroids[i];
182:       a.x += a.vx;
183:       a.y += a.vy;
184:       // Remove off‑screen
185:       if (a.x < -a.r || a.x > width + a.r || a.y < -a.r || a.y > height + a.r) {
186:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
187:         continue;
188:       }
189:       // Collision
190: if (checkCollision(ship, a)) {
191:           gameOver = true;
192:           if (!crashPlayed) { playCrash(); crashPlayed = true; }
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:     // Render
197:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
198:     // Draw starfield background
199:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
200:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
201:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
202:     for (let s of stars) {
203:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
204:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
205:     }
206:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
207:     ship.draw();
208:     // Draw asteroids with shading
209:     for (const a of asteroids) {
210:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
211:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
212:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#555');
213:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
214:       ctx.beginPath();
215:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
216:       ctx.fill();
217:     }
218:     // Score
219:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
220:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
221:     const seconds = ((timestamp - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
222:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${seconds}s`, 10, 20);
223: 
224:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
225:   }
226: 
227:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
228: })();

(End of file - total 228 lines)
</content>
